claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 2500kg marked on the frames.
The witness report notes the functional state of the hydraulic mechanism was not shown.
Maintenance history cannot be confirmed through visual inspection of the item alone.
Rear steering wheels were not shown in the report.
No manufacturer brand name was visible to the witness.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump failure or inability to hold a load.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the jack lifting a weighted pallet and holding it for 60 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-functional unit requiring a hydraulic pump rebuild.

risks.proof: A video of the pallet truck being pulled across a flat floor while loaded.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a full set of replacement rollers and steering wheels.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the hydraulic piston and the floor directly beneath the pump assembly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a seal kit replacement and service.

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic handle in use lifting a load.
Photo of the rear steering wheels and their condition.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.
Video of the release trigger functioning to lower the forks.
response.reason: The item type and capacity are confirmed by the witness. It can be priced at the worst-case functional state for a used unit with significant cosmetic wear.
